message:
♦️ **FLEX ULTIMATE V3.0.4 IS LIVE! (PREMIERE PRO)**

**Flex AI now works in steps**, **Word Pop** builds real word clips, and the **Undo** buttons really bring a cut back.

*(Windows: quit Premiere Pro completely before you install. Then restart Premiere Pro once.)*

♦️ **New: Flex AI works in steps** (AI tab)
* It looks first (the sequence, the selected clips, the frame), makes a change with the panel's own tools, checks it, and carries on until the job is done.
* Every step shows in the chat and uses credits, like a reply. Stop a run any time.

♦️ **New: Word Pop** (AutoCaptions › More)
* One clip per word, bold white with a dark edge, popping in. Every word stays editable in Essential Graphics.

♦️ **Fixed**
* **UNDO LAST AUTO CUT / UNDO LAST CLEANUP** now really undo in Premiere Pro.
* **Retakes**: a new **Undo** button brings the whole removal back.
* **Colors**: the 4-colour gradient lands again.
* **Nest Deck**: double-click to rename works again.
* **Right-click** on a saved curve, an Assets template or a deck no longer opens two menus.
* **AutoCaptions Editor**: "All captions" stays when the selection changes.
* **Windows**: the Mouse & Macros helper no longer blocks the next update.

*Panel stuck on a loading screen after an update? Quit Premiere Pro and install again with Flex Product Manager 2.1.2 or later.*
